newsitem.title: RUSSIA: One dead, 63 hurt in Russian chemical plant blast.
newsitem.headline: One dead, 63 hurt in Russian chemical plant blast.

text.p: One person died and 63 were injured in a fire at a chemical factory in Russia's Far East city of Khabarovsk, an Emergencies Ministry spokesman said on Wednesday.
A chlorine storage tank at the Khabarovsk Chemical-Pharmaceutical Factory was set ablaze during repair work on Wednesday morning.
Chlorine gas burst from the tank when workers tried to extinguish the fire with water, the spokesman said, adding that eight workers were in critical condition.
He said the fire had been extinguished and that the chlorine fumes did not threaten neighbouring buildings.
